comment: At 1920 by 1080 and a UI scale of 1, a filter dialog opens at the height of its controls rather than at 660 by 640. Curves opens first and Gaussian Blur second in the same window without a close between them, and each describe line carries the window's logical size, so the second reads shorter than the first. Gaussian Blur's Radius, in px, is its first row and its picture comes after it. Levels shows its five numbers under the captions Black, Midtone, White, Output black and Output white, and every picture has a Preview caption and a frame. Hue/Saturation/Lightness has no empty dark under its strip.
